title: VdbChunkRecord
description: Provenance-bearing vector-database record for CIS 731 PS 6. Extends the MP 5 CorpusChunk: MP 5 established record_id, track, source_id, ts_start/ts_end, text, ingest_ts and license_class for the streaming ingest; this record carries those forward under VDB names and adds the embedding, the ontology linkage and the provenance hash. A record that validates here is admissible to the index; admissibility is NOT the same as correctness, and the three properties JSON Schema structurally cannot express are listed in x-contract-enforced below.
x-contract-enforced: UnitNorm: ||vector||_2 == 1 +/- 1e-5. JSON Schema cannot compute an aggregate over an array, so this is checked in contracts.py::vdb_upsert.
HashIntegrity: source_hash == sha256(raw document bytes). Schema can check the shape of a digest, never that it is the right digest.
ChunkIdDerivation: chunk_id == sha256(doc_id|chunk_index|chunker_version). Enforced in contracts.py so re-embedding is idempotent.
EmbeddingCompleteness and NoOrphanEmbeddings are set-level invariants over the whole index and cannot be expressed about a single record at all.

chunk_id.description: SHA-256 of 'doc_id|chunk_index|chunker_version', lowercase hex. Deterministic by construction so that re-running the chunker produces the same id and vdb_upsert REPLACES rather than duplicates. A random uuid here would make every re-embed create orphans.

doc_id.description: Source-prefixed document identifier. The prefix carries provenance in the key itself (MP 5 INV-10 whitelist), so an unlisted source is detectable without a join.

chunk_index.description: Zero-based position of this chunk within its document.

chunker_version.description: Semantic version of the chunking code. Part of chunk_id, so changing the chunker necessarily changes every id and forces a full rebuild instead of silently mixing two chunkings in one index.

source_hash.description: SHA-256 of the raw source document as acquired. Detects upstream edits: if the source changes, the hash changes and the chunk is known stale.

license_class.description: Licensing status of the SOURCE DOCUMENT. INV-9 restricts corpus content to public-domain or instructor-provided material; the last two values exist so non-conforming material is representable and therefore rejectable, rather than being quietly relabelled. admit_document admits only the INV-9 set.

corpus_type.description: Which corpus family this record belongs to. Selects whether release_year or broadcast_ts is required.

release_year.description: Publication year of the work. Required for VDB corpora; the Era axis of the ontology is derived from it.

broadcast_ts.description: Broadcast timestamp. Required for ASR transcripts in place of release_year.

trope_ids.description: Tropes this chunk attests, keyed into trope_ontology.json. May be empty: most chunks attest nothing, and forcing a non-empty array would push annotators to invent labels.

embedding_model.description: Pinned model identity. Vectors from different models are not comparable, so mixing them in one index silently corrupts every similarity score.

embedding_dim.description: Vector dimension. Constrained against embedding_model below.

vector.description: The embedding, unit-normalized. Component bounds follow from unit norm. Exact length is tied to embedding_dim by contract, and the norm itself is checked in vdb_upsert.

text.description: The chunk text as embedded. Retained so a retrieved vector can be shown to a human and an attribution claim can be audited.

token_count.description: Tokens as counted by embedding_model's tokenizer. The 256 ceiling is the model's max sequence length: a larger value means the tail was silently truncated and the vector does not represent the text.

provenance_verified.description: Postcondition flag set by admit_document. vdb_upsert refuses any record where this is not true, so an unverified chunk cannot reach the index even if it is otherwise well-formed.
